description:
## Problem
- The tuned ClickHouse session pack applies only when `benchmark_type` is `olap`, `analytics`, `tpch` or `tpcds` (`benchbox/platforms/clickhouse/tuning.py:103-108`). SSB and every other benchmark are excluded, and nothing records why.
- The SSB keep decision therefore measured layout alone, while TPC-H measured layout plus pack, so the two are not comparable.
- The settings that stayed in the pack have no measured benefit. The ADR-3 ClickHouse addendum records them as "within noise (1.03× to 1.06×)" on TPC-H, which is slightly worse, not better. The settings are `max_bytes_in_join`, the external group-by and sort thresholds, `optimize_aggregation_in_order=1` and `group_by_two_level_threshold=100000`.

## Change
- With the harness, run each benchmark at SF1 on ClickHouse server (5.25 GiB rung) in these arms:
  - `notuning`;
  - tuned layout without the pack;
  - tuned layout with the full pack;
  - tuned layout with the pack minus each setting, one at a time.
- Do this for TPC-H, SSB and TPC-DS.
- Apply the benefit rule to the pack as a whole and to each setting. A setting stays only if removing it makes things worse beyond noise, or if it is needed to keep a query passing (record which query).
- Decide whether `ssb` joins the gate. Record the gate's scope and the reason for each excluded benchmark in the ADR-3 addendum. Where the reason is that it was never measured, say so.

## Decision gate
- Change the gate or the pack only as the rule's verdicts direct.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- No other benchmark joins the gate without its own measurement.
- Keep memory-safety settings (`max_bytes_in_join` and the external thresholds) if removing them makes any query fail at the 5.25 GiB rung, even when they cost time. Record the trade-off.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`. Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop 5ca12e6ca.
